title: Romus the Tyrant
summary: Raleigh names Romus the Tyrant in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). One Romus, a Tyrant of the Latines, who draue the Tuscans out and built Rome, in the same list. He is not Romus the sonne of Emathion, and not Remus. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXIV, §. V, sig. 349a
